# Every rating is read on the business impact when config.yaml declares
# data_subjects, as the quickstart's does, and on the technical impact when
# it does not, which the load warning says. Each vulnerability of the VEX
# names its basis in vens:impact-basis, its severity and score recompute
# from its vector on that basis, and vens enrich copies it. The VEX's
# metadata names rating policy 2 in vens:rating-policy, which vens enrich
# copies too.
exec vens generate --llm=mock --config-file=$QUICKSTART/config.yaml --sbom-serial-number=urn:uuid:3e671687-395b-41f5-a30f-a58921a69b79 $QUICKSTART/reports/python-slim.trivy.json business.cdx.json
! stderr 'context.data_subjects is not declared'
vex-vectors business.cdx.json 45
impact-basis business.cdx.json business
exec vens enrich --vex business.cdx.json --output business.json $QUICKSTART/reports/python-slim.trivy.json
impact-basis business.cdx.json business business.json

exec sh -c 'grep -v "^  data_subjects:" "$QUICKSTART/config.yaml" > technical.yaml'
! grep '^  data_subjects:' technical.yaml
exec vens generate --llm=mock --config-file=technical.yaml --sbom-serial-number=urn:uuid:3e671687-395b-41f5-a30f-a58921a69b79 $QUICKSTART/reports/python-slim.trivy.json technical.cdx.json
stderr 'level=WARN msg="context.data_subjects is not declared: .*, and every finding is rated on its technical impact. Declared, it is taken as the business information OWASP''s rule asks for, and every finding is rated on its business impact instead, which can move a severity up or down; with no framework in compliance_requirements, no finding rates critical unless business_criticality is critical."'
vex-vectors technical.cdx.json 45
impact-basis technical.cdx.json technical
exec vens enrich --vex technical.cdx.json --output technical.json $QUICKSTART/reports/python-slim.trivy.json
impact-basis technical.cdx.json technical technical.json
